statusCodes.SOURCE: Previously documented PRU game script; ROM encounter not fully verified

entries.name: Articuno
entries.how: Static Lv50 encounter in Seafoam Islands B1F. The checked event does not require a weather condition.

entries.name: Zapdos
entries.how: Static Lv50 encounter on Route 10 near the Power Plant. The checked event does not require a weather condition.

entries.name: Moltres
entries.how: Static Lv50 encounter in the Mt. Silver first-floor Moltres Room; not a roaming Kanto encounter.

entries.name: Mewtwo
entries.how: Find the scripted encounter. Exact Alpha 5 access prerequisite not tested.

entries.name: Mew
entries.how: Source lists a scripted encounter. Method of travelling here not tested.

entries.name: Mewduo
entries.how: Source lists a scripted encounter here; exact trigger not tested.

entries.name: Raikou
entries.how: After becoming Johto Champion, speak to the Ruins of Alph scientist. Investigate the old generator, catch Raikou and return to the lab.

entries.name: Entei
entries.how: After Raikou, enter Mt. Mortar and reach its farthest cavern. Return to the lab after catching.

entries.name: Suicune
entries.location: Cerulean Cape — far end of Route 25
entries.how: Follow the lab clue to the far end of Route 25. NOT Ruins of Alph.

entries.name: Lugia
entries.how: After Entei, reach the deepest chamber of Whirl Islands.

entries.name: Ho-Oh
entries.how: Golden Ho-Oh finale: catch all seven RELICS, complete the Elite 20 and meet Professor Oak on the summit.

entries.name: Alphoracle
entries.how: After six RELICS, inspect the final stone statue at the far-right end.

entries.name: Celebi
entries.how: After I-Unown, follow the Alpha 5 ROM-confirmed clue: Celebi awaits in Ilex Forest. Examine the old forest shrine.

entries.name: Regirock
entries.how: Find the Regirock chamber. Entrance conditions require Alpha 5 playtesting.

entries.name: Regice
entries.how: Find the Regice chamber. Entrance conditions require Alpha 5 playtesting.

entries.name: Registeel
entries.how: Find the Registeel chamber. Entrance conditions require Alpha 5 playtesting.

entries.name: Latias
entries.how: After the Steven encounter at Vermilion City, one of Latias or Latios becomes a Kanto roamer. The alternate scripted Southern Island encounter depends on access flags. Weather not verified as a trigger.

entries.name: Latios
entries.how: After the Steven encounter at Vermilion City, one of Latias or Latios becomes a Kanto roamer. The alternate scripted Southern Island encounter depends on access flags. Weather not verified as a trigger.

entries.name: Kyogre
entries.how: Source-documented encounter; Primal form is permanent in PRU.

entries.name: Groudon
entries.how: Source-documented encounter; Primal form is permanent in PRU.

entries.name: Rayquaza
entries.how: Source-documented encounter; permanent Mega form in PRU.

entries.name: Coelossus
entries.how: Exact catchable location and unlock conditions not verified from this test ROM.

entries.name: Jirachi
entries.how: Touch the White Rock outside Mt. Moon. A time-of-day branch controls the summoning scene. Catch Jirachi (Lv50) before seeking Astrachi.

entries.name: Astrachi
entries.how: After catching Jirachi, interact with the same White Rock again to summon the separate Lv70 Astrachi. It appears at the pool; the capture is one-time.

entries.name: Deoxys
entries.how: Travel to Birth Island and complete the triangular-rock puzzle to trigger Deoxys. Exact travel unlock is still awaiting Alpha 5 playtesting.

entries.name: I-Unown (Eye Relic)
entries.how: The I clue sends you below Ruins of Alph to the Eye statue after Lugia. This form shares the Unown Pokédex number.

entries.name: Ancient Guardian Dragonite
entries.location: Tin Tower Roof — Kimono Girls ceremony
entries.how: Special non-catchable Lv60 Guardian battle during the Kimono Girls ceremony. This is the approved blue-crystal Elite Redux Mega Dragonite artwork, not standard Dragonite.
